source: Real browser, isolated backend and database; synthetic accounts and questions; original snapshots restored.

checks.name: saved edited draft is shown with its own status and actual question count
continue editing opens the saved draft including the edited question
refresh and returning to overview preserves the saved draft
the draft respects status and search filters in both overview views
a different account cannot see this account’s saved draft
different unsaved browser content is preserved and the saved version can be opened and reversed
a temporary-load failure is visible and does not block the survey list
the entry remains usable on a 390px viewport
